description:
`VirtualPath` becomes `Cow<'static, str>`-backed so the well-known repository paths are `pub const` associated items, with an exhaustive round-trip test proving each constant canonical.

## Background

`VirtualPath` is `String`-backed through `RootRelativePath::Descendant(String)` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/path.rs`), which blocks `const` construction. Changing the payload to `Cow<'static, str>` makes `Cow::Borrowed` const-constructible, so the well-known paths become `pub const` associated items (`VirtualPath::GATES`, `EVENTS`, `CONFIG`, `INDEX`, `RULES`, and the rest).

Parsing and deserialization produce `Cow::Owned`; `Ord`/`Hash`/`Eq` semantics are unchanged (`Borrowed("x") == Owned("x")`), so const and parsed keys collide correctly in the `BTreeMap`-keyed image. Because consts bypass the reserved-path `checked()` guard, one test iterates every associated const via a `VirtualPath::ALL_KNOWN` list and asserts round-trip equality through the fallible constructor, proving each const canonical and non-reserved.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `VirtualPath` is `Cow<'static, str>`-backed, with `Ord`/`Hash`/`Eq` semantics preserved so const and parsed keys collide correctly.
- [hard] REQ-02: The well-known repository paths are `pub const` associated items of `VirtualPath`, enumerated by a `VirtualPath::ALL_KNOWN` list.
- [hard] REQ-03: A test iterates every associated const via `VirtualPath::ALL_KNOWN` and asserts round-trip equality through the fallible constructor, proving each const canonical and non-reserved.

## Notes

Migrating the fallible `VirtualPath::data("literal")` call sites to these constants is separate work; this task delivers the representation, the constants, and the round-trip test.
title: Cow-backed VirtualPath with well-known path constants
